reports.title: Matthew Singh: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: The entry and conveyance of illicit items into the prison was a major threat to its stability. In the previous 12 months, there had been over 1,000 reported finds, including 500 relating to drugs. The positive mandatory drug test rate for the previous year was high at 33.5%, and suspicion-led testing had yielded positive results of 77% over the same period. It was not surprising, therefore, that in our survey, 60% of prisoners said it was easy to get illicit drugs at Berwyn
concerns.hazard: illicit drug entry and use in prison

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the ongoing availability and use of psychoactive substances within HMP Berwyn as a risk to prisoner health. They describe the same hazard—illicit drug accessibility—despite differing data and timeframes.
